Key_Result: 90 plots, 127 canonical taxa and 1,750 individuals integrated.
Validated structural evidence represented 89.37% of total abundance.
Four PCA axes explained >70% cumulative ecological variance.
Habitat, Management Zone and their interaction structured multiple ecological dimensions.
Five of six ecological-domain pairs remained or became significant after Habitat/Zone adjustment.
Four ecological states validated from 82 complete >=75%-coverage plots.
Core dominated by T1 dense-wood conservative state.
Buffer dominated by T2 structurally developed diverse state.
Transition dominated by T4/T3 states with low WD, high SLA and lower richness.
Eleven final ecological indicators retained for multidimensional repeat monitoring.
